name: European Countries Data Collection
description: Gather and structure all data needed for European countries (44 countries)

steps: Create src/data/countries.js file
Define COUNTRIES object with 44 European countries
Each country has: lat, lng, subregion, fact fields
Verify all country names are spelled correctly
Verify coordinates are reasonable for each country
Export COUNTRY_NAMES as sorted array

prds.description: Country facts are educational and appropriate
steps: Review all country facts for accuracy
Verify facts are 15-30 words
Verify facts are educational and family-friendly
Verify facts are non-political
Verify no spelling or grammar errors

prds.description: European countries GeoJSON acquired and processed
steps: Download GeoJSON from Natural Earth Data
Filter to European countries only
Simplify geometry using Mapshaper
Verify file size is < 3MB
Save as public/assets/europe.json
Verify all 44 countries are present
Verify properties.name matches country names in countries.js
Create src/data/countryAdjacency.js file
Define COUNTRY_ADJACENCY object with border relationships
Verify all 44 countries are defined
Verify adjacency is bidirectional (if A borders B, B borders A)
Handle edge cases (islands, microstates)
Export areAdjacent() helper function
Verify Western Europe countries are correct
Verify Central Europe countries are correct
Verify Northern Europe countries are correct
Verify Southern Europe countries are correct
Verify Eastern Europe countries are correct
Ensure total equals 44 countries

prds.description: All data files are valid and loadable
steps: Verify countries.js has no syntax errors
Verify countryAdjacency.js has no syntax errors
Verify europe.json is valid GeoJSON
Test loading GeoJSON in QGIS or online viewer
Verify country centroids are reasonable
